_: Listening notes on the BASILISK SYNTH 1.2.2 demos (best of up to four takes each; XP renders are not bit-identical run to run). 'drop' removes an automatic flag that listening showed to be a false alarm or only informative; 'note' is shown on the page.

glass-steps.note: Its quietest notes (velocity 84 on a soft, short-envelope XP Ding) barely sound: 3 of 10 onsets were not clearly heard in the best of four 1.2.2 takes (1.2.1's take had all 10).

click-harp.note: A quiet preset; one of its 32 arpeggio notes is not clearly heard (the same in every take).

recycle-perc.note: A quiet preset; 2 of its 26 hits are not clearly heard (the same in every take).

macro-echoes.note: Macro 1 steps the echo count (N), so Windows rebuilds the recorders; chords that land during a rebuild are dropped (3 of 8, in every one of four takes).

logoff-strings.note: A quiet preset: about -45 LUFS before the demo's levelling.
